weapon.d:
At the start of turns 3 and 4, inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-6,【Gravity】,【Guard】, and status preventing counterattacks on closest foes within 5 spaces of unit through their next actions.
【Gravity】
Restricts target's movement to 1 space through its next action.
【Guard】
Inflicts Special cooldown charge -1 on unit per attack during combat through its next action. (Only highest value applied. Does not stack.)

special.d: Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Res.
Boosts damage by 80% of unit's Res.

b.d: At start of turn, if any foe's Res ≤ unit's Res-3 and that foe is adjacent to another foe, inflicts Res-3 on that foe through its next action.
At start of turn, if any foe's Res ≤ unit's Res-3 and that foe is adjacent to another foe, inflicts Res-5 on that foe through its next action.
At start of turn, if any foe's Res ≤ unit's Res-3 and that foe is adjacent to another foe, inflicts Res-7 on that foe through its next action.

c.d: At start of turn, inflicts Atk-3 on foes in cardinal directions with Res < unit's Res through their next actions.
At start of turn, inflicts Atk-4 on foes in cardinal directions with Res < unit's Res through their next actions.
At start of turn, inflicts Atk-5 on foes in cardinal directions with Res < unit's Res through their next actions.
